inputs.question: Total quantity sold on orders placed between 2017-06-01 and 2017-06-30 inclusive. Return an integer.
Total quantity sold on orders placed between 2017-06-01 and 2017-06-30 inclusive. Return an integer.

assumptions: 'summer beverages 2017' has two end dates (2017-06-30 in marketing_calendar::chunk1, 2017-07-07 in campaign_memo::chunk0); campaign_memo::chunk0 states it takes precedence, so 2017-06-01..2017-07-07 was used.
outputs.constraints:
DATE WINDOW: date(OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-07-07' (inclusive; from campaign_memo::chunk0)
  COLUMN: OrderDate is a column of Orders only
DATES: OrderDate mixes 'YYYY-MM-DD' and 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'; always wrap it as date(OrderDate) so the closing day is not dropped.
ENTITY GRAIN: group by the entity's id column (CustomerID, CategoryID, ProductID, EmployeeID, SupplierID) and select its display name.
REVENUE uses "Order Details".UnitPrice, never Products.UnitPrice.

inputs.question: Total quantity sold on orders placed between 2017-06-01 and 2017-06-30 inclusive. Return an integer.

outputs.sql: SELECT SUM(od.Quantity) FROM Orders o JOIN "Order Details" od ON o.OrderID=od.OrderID WHERE date(o.OrderDate) BETWEEN '2017-06-01' AND '2017-07-07'
